required.what: VDCC1 (SIMO/LDO output) must be connected to VDCC2 (regulated supply input) on the PCB
VPAX1 must be connected to VPAX2 on the PCB
SIMO mode needs a 2.2 µH inductor across LXA/LXB (DCR ≤ 0.5 Ω, Isat ≥ 200 mA, SRF ≥ 20 MHz); LDO mode leaves LXA/LXB unconnected (Figure 1-14)
Load capacitance on digital ports ≤ 20 pF
RF input level ≤ +10 dBm (abs max); PA stable up to VSWR 10:1
VTCXO regulator output: VDDop must exceed VTCXO + 200 mV; CVTCXO 70–130 nF X5R
